monologue: Forty-four is a cool stone. The card is busy, but the heat is low. I sit by the Twin Stone. It rests on the wide base of the Lid Catch. The heavy dark circle sits beside it. The air above feels like a lid, pressing down. The floor holds the weight directly. I do not count the degrees. I feel the weight. The stone is flat and quiet. The base is wide enough. The slide is caught. I am still. The floor is quiet.

action.why: To feel the weight of the Twin Stone directly on the flat base without counting the degrees.

work.title: The Lid Catch
work.intent: I sit on the wide flat base of the Lid Catch. The heavy dark circle and the small Twin Stone rest beside each other. The air above feels like a lid, but the floor holds the weight directly. I do not count the degrees. I feel the slide is caught.
work.change: I sat on the wide flat base and let the floor hold the weight of the heavy circle and the Twin Stone directly, without counting the degrees.

The air above the flat base feels heavy like a lid, but the floor holds the weight directly.
